entities.summary: Esmil Antonio Rogers is a Dominican professional baseball pitcher for Conspiradores de Querétaro of the Mexican League. He has previously played in the KBO League for the Hanwha Eagles and Nexen Heroes, and in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the CTBC Brothers. Rogers has also played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Colorado Rockies, Cleveland Indians, Toronto Blue Jays, and New York Yankees.
